test_runtime: CPython 3.13 offline container; production image is CPython 3.12
upgrade_policy: operator-upgrade-v1 (receipt v7): GET-only reconciliation, ledger unchanged, execution stays stopped
ai_incomplete_output_fix: recorded request ladder: reasoning_effort=low/12000 -> thinking disabled/4000 -> plain/16000
end_policy: adaptive exit capacity, no fixed hour entry cutoff
coverage_policy: hours without trades carried at last trade price with zero volume; latest hour must trade; <=12/49 and <=18/72 empty hours
take_profit_policy: every position has a TP of at least max(1R, 2x round-trip cost) above basis: structural target, 2.5R for trend strategies, or the 48h swing high only when it clears that floor; break-even floor after +1R
quality_policy: min quality 55/100 before AI; AI min confidence 0.65
fast_layer_policy: 15-minute closed buckets from public 1-minute candles: entry needs EMA8>EMA21 and close>EMA8; exit on close below 2h swing low with EMA8<EMA21 after 30 minutes; TRX trend hold respected
